reviews.text: Lauren Bridgers. Lauren Bridgers

Too much time. Unfortunately, this has been a very disappointing experience. Creating videos in this app takes an excessive amount of time, and one of the biggest limitations is that it does not allow you to upload your own videos to add subtitles directly, which is essential for professional content creation.

On top of that, I was charged for an entire year upfront. The app does not allow you to cancel, does not offer refunds, and provides no flexibility, even when the product clearly does not meet professional workflow needs.

This makes it extremely difficult if not impossible to work efficiently. Transparency about limitations and refund policies should be much clearer before charging users for a full year.

I would not recommend this app to professionals who rely on speed, customization, and control over their own video content.
